comment: --build writes here (never over existing files):   MECHANIC_W86_v02.blend         = MECHANIC_W86_v01.blend with the v02 wrench (the animation source, LOD0 only)   MECHANIC_W86_v02_opt_v02.blend = MECHANIC_W86_v01_opt_v02.blend with the v02 wrench in LOD0/1/2   MECHANIC_W86_v02_opt_v02.fbx   = its game FBX (the opt_v02 export: rig + Body/Face/Outfit/Wrench_RightHand _LOD0/1/2,                                    the Idle clip only, the same export options)   wrench_MECHANIC_W86_v02.json   = layout, triangles, checks Everything except the Wrench_RightHand meshes is the v01 data unchanged (same objects, weights, materials, shape keys).
